_readme: Free 'Top Rated' highlight (NOT the paid Featured tier). A shop shows as Top Rated only if its slug is in verified_slugs (Google rating + count checked by hand/scripts on the date noted) AND its CSV rating/review_count still meet min_rating/min_reviews. Add a slug to include_slugs to opt in a near-miss (e.g. a shop just under the thresholds). Summaries are written only from Google review text we actually read; edit freely, but never add quotes or claims that are not in the reviews. Threshold raised to 4.9+ on 2026-11-22 (Dennis approved).
